description: Contextual medium-density residential district. Quality Housing bulk regulations are mandatory. Produces high lot-coverage 6-7 story buildings compatible with established neighborhoods.

bulk.far_note: UAP (Universal Affordability Preference) standard; community facility FAR per ZR §24-11

height_setback.street_wall_setback_wide_st: 10 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_setback_narrow_st: 15 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_location: No closer to street line than buildings within 150 ft on same block, up to 15 ft depth
height_setback.notes: Per ZR §23-432 table (R6A, R6-1 rows). Quality Housing max building height 75 ft standard; 95 ft with qualifying affordable/senior housing.

front.requirement: Per §23-322: min depth varies; new buildings should be no closer to street than adjacent buildings within 150 ft
front.note: Open area between street wall and street line may be used for permitted obstructions per §23-41

side.requirement: Per §23-335: none required for Quality Housing in R6A contextual districts
side.note: No rear yard required where rear lot line coincides with side lot line of adjoining zoning lot (§23-342)

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft depth from street to street — required only per paragraph (a) of §23-343
rear.note: No rear yard required at lot line coinciding with adjoining side lot line

permitted_uses.community_facility: Per ZR §24-11: community facility FAR shall not exceed residential FAR unless modified
permitted_uses.commercial: Not permitted as primary use; C1 overlay required for local retail
permitted_uses.parking: 50% of dwelling units required off-street parking outside front yard

dob_filing_notes: File under NB (New Building) or Alt1 (Alteration Type 1) in DOB NOW
Quality Housing Program compliance certification required
If within 100 ft of wide street and qualifying affordable: FAR 3.90 applies — verify with NYC DCP zoning map
BSA variance may be needed for minor yard deviations
